definitions.revenue: Sum of order totals (tax and shipping included) for orders placed in the window.
definitions.contractSavings: For every line: (highest unit price seen for that SKU anywhere) minus (price this account actually paid), times quantity. What the negotiated rate has been worth.
definitions.contractLeakage: For every line: (price paid) minus (lowest unit price this same account has ever paid for that SKU), times quantity, counted only when positive. Money left on the table at this account's own agreed rate. It never compares an account to a rate it was not offered.
definitions.reorderCadence: Median number of days between consecutive orders. An account is flagged overdue when days since its last order exceed 1.5x that median.
definitions.buyerConcentration: Count of distinct buyer email addresses that have placed an order. One buyer means the account stops if that person leaves — continuity risk for the customer, account risk for Keystone.
definitions.exceptionValue: Order value sitting in a non-terminal state past its reason-specific age threshold. This is revenue that has stopped moving.
definitions.overLimit: Order total above the business unit's buyerLimit custom field. With limitExceededBehavior = pending these require an approver before release.
definitions.quoteAge: Days since the quote request was submitted. Quotes older than 3 days convert materially worse.
